title: Toward Adversarially Robust World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent dynamic world models have proven to be highly versatile tools for embodied artificial intelligence systems, enabling online action planning, safe policy evaluation, and scalable policy learning. However, this versatility makes world models a vulnerable and centralized point of failure as a compromised model can impact planning, evaluation, and training at once. Therefore it is critical that the security and robustness properties of world models are properly understood before they are universally deployed in embodied AI systems. In this work we take a unifying approach towards this understanding, developing two novel attacks against world models, named state hallucination and dynamic shift attacks, aimed directly at impacting downstream systems, and proposing a new theoretical lens through which to study the robustness of latent dynamic world models. Through our analysis we identify robust latent space encoders as the key component

translated_title: 迈向对抗鲁棒的世界模型
translated_abstract: 潜在动态世界模型已被证明是具身人工智能系统的高度通用工具，能够支持在线动作规划、安全的策略评估以及可扩展的策略学习。然而，这种通用性也使世界模型成为一个脆弱的集中式故障点，因为一旦模型被攻破，就可能同时影响规划、评估和训练。因此，在将世界模型普遍部署于具身AI系统之前，充分理解其安全性与鲁棒性至关重要。在这项工作中，我们采取统一的方法来推进这一理解，开发了两种针对世界模型的新型攻击——状态幻觉攻击和动态偏移攻击——直接旨在影响下游系统，并提出了一种新的理论视角来研究潜在动态世界模型的鲁棒性。通过我们的分析，我们识别出鲁棒的潜在空间编码器是其中的关键组件。
tldr: 该论文提出了针对世界模型的两种新型攻击（状态幻觉攻击与动态偏移攻击），并建立了研究潜在动态世界模型鲁棒性的新理论框架，发现鲁棒的潜在空间编码器是保障世界模型安全的关键。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two novel attacks against world models—state hallucination and dynamic shift attacks—and proposes a new theoretical lens for studying the robustness of latent dynamic world models, identifying robust latent space encoders as the key component.
